scope_caveats: Operating datacenter and new power infrastructure have distinct lifecycle scopes. No new halls, campus-wide nonoperation, added IT capacity or whole-campus completion is inferred.
The locator is an existing same-campus datacenter constituent, not the exact new substation footprint or official boundary.
July1 is a conservative representation of explicit July precision, not an exact observation or start day.
Public contract attachment has unfilled contractor fields; July report supplies execution and contractor.
OSM object is not independently tagged datacenter. Explicit official datacenter address plus canonical website/short_name support the analyst association.
Nominatim reverse-address and OSM street/district labels differ from official Praça/ Centro Histórico wording. Their equality is not claimed.
Completed earlier recovery items and remote DR are excluded. August17 future September electrical target does not prove completion.

holds.remaining_gate: No exact authoritative parcel/site map or reusable source-specific point tied to the campus. Farm/locality/road/nearby CPQD coordinates do not close this gate.
